properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for Kubernetes: the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier delivers RBAC and managed-identity controls eliminating shared credentials, TLS / HTTPS enforcement preventing in-transit interception, encryption-at-rest with service-managed keys, key and certificate lifecycle hygiene (rotation, expiration, validity), and tagging, SKU, and naming controls for cost and ownership accountability.
